messages.subject: Unable to deploy shiny app.
parts:
Hi,

On following the steps listed on http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/shinyapps.html for deploying the shiny application, I face the following error when I type the deployApp() command :

"Error: /v1/applications/ 400 - Validation error: field 'name' is invalid application name. application name must be at least 4 characters, and may only contain letters, numbers, dashes and hyphens.. "

Kindly let me know the solution for this problem.

Thanks,
Sanchit

messages.subject: Re: Unable to deploy shiny app.
parts:
Does the name of folder your server.R and ui.R are in contain four or more letters? It should also be your Working directory if you want to use 'deployApp()' without specifying the path to your app.
Anders
